CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: Costco Wholesale currently operates 928 warehouses worldwide and 115 warehouses across Canada.The first Canadian Costco Wholesale location opened in Burnaby, BC in October 1985.Costco Wholesale employs over 50,000 people in Canada.Its Canadian head office is located at 415 West Hunt Club Road in Ottawa.Revenues from corporate sales for the fiscal year ending August 31, 2025 , were $269.9 billion (US) (COST - NASDAQ).
